decisions.reason: As the flagship reusable citrus harvesting crate, its strategic option value remains high and uncertainty is unresolved, so keeping it open is cheap.
With its own product page and several models, the foldable large container still holds option value while market uncertainty persists, so it is worth keeping.
The stackable plastic crate is a less differentiated option, but with no negative signal and low keeping cost, it should be kept until uncertainty resolves.
The medium-duty rackable pallet is a standard line with little strategic focus, but its option remains inexpensive to hold and results are not yet decisive, so keep it.
The spill-retention pallet has dedicated marketing and unresolved demand from environmental-compliance needs, making the option worth keeping open.
With its own page and a differentiated load-retention feature, the pallet's option value is still uncertain but cheap to maintain, so keep it.
